name: komoot
description: komoot helps people discover outdoor routes and points of interest near any location. The connector lets Claude find hiking, cycling, running, and mountain biking routes from komoot’s community-verified route library, plus highlights such as viewpoints, summits, waterfalls, cafés, and mountain huts. Results can be shown as an interactive map or carousel widget with route details, photos, distance, elevation, duration, difficulty, and links to komoot.

_published_faq.name: How do I add komoot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add komoot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://claude.main.komoot.net/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the komoot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: komoot provides these MCP tools: find_routes_by_location and find_highlights_by_location.
komoot does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
komoot is developed by komoot. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
